title: 别烧了，用AI
summary: 绝望的火锅店老板想烧店骗保，被朋友用一套AI营销方案拉回人间，最后靠AI把店盘活了。

shots.dialogue: 房租到期，三天没开张……烧了吧，烧了还有笔保险。
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot, medium shot. A tired Chinese man in his 40s, apron over a stained shirt, sits alone on a plastic stool inside a closed, dim hotpot restaurant at midnight, holding a lighter in his trembling hand. Cold blue moonlight slants through the gap of the roller shutter door, a small warm desk lamp lights only half of his face. Subject in sharp focus, shelves and stacked chairs behind him heavily blurred with shallow depth of field. Cold blue and dim orange color contrast, low saturation, heavy grain, oppressive mood. Slow dolly-in with subtle handheld shake, the lighter flame flickers once.

shots.image_prompt: 竖屏中景，深夜打烊的破旧火锅店，一位四十岁左右的中国男店主穿着油渍围裙独自坐在塑料凳上，低头盯着手里一只金属打火机；背后是摞起的圆凳与落灰的调料架。构图偏左三分法，人物位于画面左侧，右侧留出昏暗空间。主体打火机与脸清晰锐利，背景货架强烈虚化。冷蓝月光从卷帘门缝隙斜切进入，桌上一盏暖黄小灯只照亮半张脸，冷暖对比强烈。整体低饱和、暗调、略带颗粒感，压抑氛围。
shots.image_prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 medium shot, late-night closed shabby hotpot restaurant, a Chinese male owner in his 40s wearing a greasy apron sits alone on a plastic stool, staring down at a metal lighter in his hand, stacked round stools and dusty condiment shelves behind him. Rule-of-thirds composition with the man on the left, dark negative space on the right. Lighter and face tack sharp, background shelves heavily blurred. Cold blue moonlight slashes in through the shutter gap, a small warm desk lamp lights only half his face, strong warm-cool contrast. Low saturation, dark moody grade, slight film grain, oppressive atmosphere.
shots.camera: 缓慢推近，轻微手持晃动

shots.dialogue: 烧什么烧！起来，我把AI给你请来了。
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot, medium close-up. A younger Chinese man in a jacket bursts through the shutter door and grabs the lighter out of the owner's hand, motion blurred jacket hem and swinging door. The owner looks up startled. Subject sharp, background restaurant interior heavily bokeh-blurred. Warm street light floods in from behind the door creating a bright rim light on both men, dust motes floating in the light beam. Energetic handheld camera, quick push-in then small whip pan, high contrast lighting shift from cold blue to warm amber.

shots.image_prompt: 竖屏中近景，一位穿夹克的年轻中国男性猛地掀开卷帘门闯进店内，一手夺过店主手里的打火机，动作带起动势；店主惊讶抬头，两人一高一低形成对角构图。主体二人清晰，背景店内环境重度虚化。门外暖黄路灯逆光打进来，在两人肩头勾出明亮轮廓光，空气中浮尘可见。冷暖光在画面中交接。紧张但有希望的情绪，轻微动感模糊。
shots.image_prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 medium close-up, a younger Chinese man in a jacket violently lifts the shutter door and storms in, snatching the lighter from the owner's hand, dynamic motion in his body; the owner looks up in shock. The two form a diagonal composition, one standing over the seated one. Both men tack sharp, restaurant interior heavily bokeh-blurred. Warm amber streetlight backlights them from the doorway, rim-lighting their shoulders, dust motes visible in the beam. Cold and warm light meeting in frame. Tense but hopeful mood, slight motion blur on the moving arm.
shots.camera: 手持快速推入，随动作小幅甩镜

shots.dialogue: 让它写文案、剪视频、做菜单——你不用烧，你只要上架。
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot, over-the-shoulder medium shot. Two Chinese men lean over a laptop on a hotpot table, screen glow lighting their faces from below, a smartphone beside it playing a looping food video. Rapid montage feel inside one take: on-screen interface panels flick open. Subjects sharp, restaurant background blurred into warm bokeh. Screen is the main light source, cyan-white, contrasted with a small warm lamp on the wall. Slow orbit around the table, then settle into a slight push-in.

shots.image_prompt: 竖屏过肩中景，两位中国男性伏在火锅店的方桌上盯着一台笔记本电脑，屏幕冷白的光由下往上照亮两人的脸，旁边手机正在循环播放一段冒着热气的火锅短视频。构图以电脑屏幕为视觉中心，两人一左一右夹住画面。人物与屏幕清晰，背景店铺环境虚化成暖色光斑。屏幕光为主光（冷白），墙面小壁灯为辅光（暖黄），冷暖交汇。科技感与烟火气并存。
shots.image_prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 over-the-shoulder medium shot, two Chinese men leaning over a laptop on a hotpot table, cold white screen glow lighting their faces from below, a smartphone next to it looping a steaming hotpot food video. The laptop screen is the visual center, the two men framing it left and right. Men and screen tack sharp, restaurant background dissolving into warm bokeh. Screen light as key (cool white), small wall lamp as fill (warm amber), cool and warm meeting. Tech feel mixed with street-food warmth.
shots.camera: 绕桌缓慢环绕后轻微推近

shots.dialogue: 老板！还有位置吗？我们刷到你家视频来的！
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot, wide-to-medium. Now-bustling hotpot restaurant at night, a queue of young customers with phones out stretches out the door, steam billowing from boiling copper pots on every table, neon sign glowing above. A young woman at the front of the line grins toward camera. Foreground diners sharp, deep rows of tables blurred in warm bokeh. Rich warm tungsten lighting mixed with red-orange broth glow, lively saturated colors. Slow crane-up from table level to reveal the full queue, then gentle pan right.

shots.image_prompt: 竖屏由中景过渡到全景，夜晚热闹的火锅店，年轻顾客举着手机在门口排起长队，店内每桌铜锅沸腾冒白汽，门头霓虹灯牌亮起。构图以前景一对正在涮锅的客人为实，队伍向后延伸虚化形成纵深。前景人物与锅物清晰，纵深桌位暖色光斑虚化。暖钨丝灯为主光，番茄红锅底反光为点缀光，色彩饱满热烈。蒸汽与灯光交织，烟火气十足。
shots.image_prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 medium-to-wide shot, a lively hotpot restaurant at night, young customers holding phones queuing out the front door, copper pots boiling and steaming on every table inside, a neon shop sign glowing. Foreground pair of diners are sharp anchors, the queue receding into blurred depth. Foreground people and pots tack sharp, background tables dissolving into warm bokeh. Warm tungsten key light, tomato-red broth reflecting as accent light, rich saturated colors. Steam weaving through the light, full of street-food life.
shots.camera: 从桌面上摇升到全景，再缓慢右移

shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot, close-up then pull back to a two-shot. The owner smiles and drops a slice of tripe into the boiling red broth, steam curling up; his friend clinks a beer glass against his. Then camera pulls back to reveal the bright new LED sign reading the shop name glowing behind them. Faces sharp and warm, background customers blurred into soft warm bokeh. Golden warm lighting, gentle steam haze, relieved joyful mood. Slow pull-back and slight tilt-up to the glowing sign, steam drifting through frame.
